population: Dashboard primary balanced-camera cohort, accepted morning days and hours, temporal-eligible snapshots, excluding cameras used in the earlier eight-frame spot check
draw: Sample 20 distinct cameras without replacement. Allocate weekend day and local hour by pack quotas. Choose a weekday date uniformly among that camera's accepted days with that hour. Choose one eligible frame uniformly within each chosen camera, date, and hour. Randomize order within each ZIP.
scope: Matched review of weekday and weekend morning snapshots used for the traffic comparison. Coverage rules and prior-camera exclusion limit inference to this sampling design.
